name: Surface Treatment
structure_example: Process > Step > Work element, e.g. Plating Line > Electroplating Bath > Machine (rectifier/bath) / Method (current density) / Material (plating solution)
function_example: Deposits a corrosion-resistant coating of specified thickness uniformly across the part surface

failure_chains_starter.fe: Plated fastener corrodes prematurely in service, weakening the joint
failure_chains_starter.fm: Insufficient plating thickness on the threaded region
failure_chains_starter.fc: Plating bath current density set below the qualified process window
failure_chains_starter.pc: Process parameter SOP with tolerance band + operator training
failure_chains_starter.dc: X-ray fluorescence thickness check per lot + first-piece verification each shift

failure_chains_starter.fe: Heat-treated component distorts, causing a downstream assembly fit issue
failure_chains_starter.fc: Non-uniform quench flow from a partially clogged quench tank nozzle
failure_chains_starter.pc: Preventive maintenance schedule for quench nozzles
failure_chains_starter.dc: CMM dimensional check on a defined sampling plan post-heat-treat

special_characteristics_guidance: Coating thickness and case-hardening depth on load-bearing or corrosion-critical features are the most common SC candidates in this domain.
